items.title: Tensoring a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes against any complex is a quasi-isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tensoring any complex against a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes yields a quasi-isomorphism of total complexes. The proof replaces the arbitrary complex by a K-flat resolution and considers the commutative square of total complexes built from the resolution, the original complex and the two K-flat complexes. Since the vertical maps induced by the resolution and the top horizontal map induced by the given quasi-isomorphism are quasi-isomorphisms, the bottom horizontal map is one as well, which is the assertion.
